description: Enumerate URLs under a site or page without fetching each one. Tries, in this order and regardless of what is cached: sitemap.xml (from robots.txt or the conventional path; gzip is unpacked up to the body-size limit and a `warning:` line is added when it cannot be read), then the llms.txt the page advertises, then RSS/Atom feeds, then falls back to links found in the page itself. The response header reports which source was used (`source:`), the `count:`, and `(truncated)` when more than 200 links were cut. Each link is one line, `- <title> — <url>` (title omitted when unknown; for llms.txt it is `name: description`). `filter` narrows by substring or `*` glob against URL and link text; an empty result states whether the filter removed everything or the source had no links. Each source is cached like a page (15 minutes by default, up to 24 hours when Cache-Control max-age says so), so repeating the call with another filter does not hit the site again. Use it to find the right page before `fetch`. It does not return page content, reads the first 3 child sitemaps of a sitemap index in order and stops reading further children once 200 links are collected (filter is applied afterwards, so a URL found only in an unread child cannot be matched), and never guesses an llms.txt location.

filter.description: Substring match against URL/link text, or a glob using *

name: links
title: List links from a page (sitemap/llms.txt/RSS-first)
